strings.dlg.c4.lev_01.irina: Irina Belova said you would come. And that you can be trusted. She rarely says that.
strings.dlg.c4.lev_01.secrecy: At this hour, Morozov, and alone? Whoever comes alone wants something that isn’t in the duty book.
strings.dlg.c4.lev_04.swap: Three wagons in January, rebooked with no destination. In Veltrava they were called C-17. A German carries their list now.
strings.dlg.c4.lev_04.elena: Three wagons in January, rebooked with no destination. In Veltrava they were called C-17. Their list hangs in a coat, ticket 27.
strings.dlg.c4.tun_08.secrecy: Because you can keep quiet, anyone can see that. And because my name will be on no paper, Morozov. None.
strings.dlg.c4.mar_02.evidence: I don’t want to ride. I am a draughtsman at the General Building Office, and I collect what is in no report. The loop is new.
strings.dlg.c4.mar_02.suspicion: I don’t want to ride. I am a draughtsman at the General Building Office – not on duty today. This loop here is new.
strings.dlg.c4.mar_04.admit: Building works, the notice says. – No. I have stopped repeating notices.
strings.dlg.c4.mar_12.pocket: I drew the site plan for these clearances. And a room on the Line. I want to know what for.
strings.dlg.c4.sid_08.split: On Tuesday, in this wagon. Pjotr is on the same list – I carry it with me.
strings.dlg.c4.sid_08.swap: On Tuesday, in this wagon. And Pjotr with her. A German carries his name through Berlin now.
strings.dlg.c4.sid_08.elena: On Tuesday, in this wagon. And Pjotr with her. His list hangs in a coat in Veltrava.
strings.dlg.c4.sid_10.trust: Then I’ll collect numbers. And in Berlin someone collects the cards to match. Together it can be counted, Lev.
strings.dlg.c4.cnt_03.kessler: Adler – Herr Kessler recommended you to the office. Reliable, he writes. Which file?
strings.dlg.c4.cnt_03.suspicion: Adler. Your own office was asking about you recently. Well, ventilation is ventilation. Which file?
strings.choice.c4d.name_marta.pocket: Give Marta Vogel’s name – the Lindner file would join Sheet 7, evidence with signatures, before Tuesday
strings.choice.c4d.protect_marta.report: Give no name – ‘I heard it on the street.’ In Veltrava you already reported someone once
strings.dlg.c4.react.name_marta: Vogel, Marta. Tram, Route 74 – we’ll find that. Thank you, Herr Adler. The Lindner file, here you are.
strings.dlg.c4.react.protect_marta: On the street. Then the file stays in the cabinet, Herr Adler. Come back when the street has a name.
